verificationAudit.observation: v1 fixture failed compilation because panel static type was Window; CreateVoiceDevice belongs to the concrete private panel.
verificationAudit.repair: Use the existing reflection test seam; compile phase now compiles generated child and entire fixture before a native journey.

verificationAudit.observation: v2 exact-text Until hid actual successful completion state behind generic UI timeout.
verificationAudit.repair: Await VoiceId null and assert exact transcript with actual UI/status; retain child response and UI in UTF8.
verificationAudit.causalLimit: Default Console.Write encoding was a hypothesis, not an experimentally established cause of v2. Explicit UTF8 is verified in the repaired native journey.

verificationAudit.observation: v3 passed exact transcript/modality but Read reply was disabled after direct fixture mutation appended an assistant turn without rendering.
verificationAudit.repair: Invoke production RenderChat after model setup and assert ready assistant precondition before pressing native Read reply.

verificationAudit.observation: Existing ordinary read guard failed because generic error text no longer named 64 KiB. Numeric limit remained unchanged.
verificationAudit.repair: Preserve 64 KiB refusal for ordinary requests and report the separate voice-only cap. Existing maintained oversized request assertion is the recurrence guard.
verificationAudit.verification: v5 bridge fixture passes16, chat43 and cards51; v5 native voice36 passes.

scopeLimits: VoiceDeviceFixture substitutes recording and playback devices. This verifies native WPF state/control/transport, cancellation and modality, not physical microphone/speaker behavior.
Canonical private fixture-PUI receipts establish exact environment/conversation/request/operation matching; no actual operator acceptance claimed.
Exact installed Ubuntu/macOS/Windows matrix, physical audio, macOS runtime, independent acceptance, execution certificate and shipment remain unverified.
